title: Expressive robot
description: A friendly low-poly robot character, rigged and animated: Idle, Walking, Running, Jump, Dance, Death, Punch, Wave, ThumbsUp and more, plus three facial expressions. About 4.5 units tall; scale 0.35 for a 1.6-unit player. A ready-made player or NPC for a platformer or adventure game.
author: Tomás Laulhé (Quaternius), via three.js examples

title: Grass texture
description: A 64×64 seamless mottled green grass tile for ground and platform tops. Use NearestFilter for a crisp pixel look and RepeatWrapping to tile it.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Wooden crate texture
description: A 64×64 wooden crate face with planks and a dark frame, for boxes, crates and obstacles.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Coin pickup sound
description: A short bright two-note chiptune blip for picking up a coin or item.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Jump sound
description: A rising chiptune sweep for a jump.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Hit sound
description: A crunchy noise burst for getting hit, losing a life or bonking an enemy.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Platformer controller
description: Keyboard run-and-jump for a third-person platformer: WASD or arrows to move (relative to the camera if given), Shift to run, Space to jump, gravity, and box collision so the character lands on and bumps into platforms. Falling off the world respawns at the start.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach
exports.signature: attach(object, opts) → { update(dt), dispose(), velocity, grounded, state }
exports.does: moves object from the keyboard each update; state is idle, walk, run or jump, for an animator

options.name: solids
options.does: what the character stands on and collides with (their bounding boxes, taken once)

options.name: size
options.does: the collision box; object.position is its feet

options.name: camera
options.does: if given, movement is relative to where it looks

hooks.name: onJump
hooks.does: called as the character leaves the ground (play a sound)

hooks.name: onFall
hooks.default: teleport back to the spawn point
hooks.does: called when the character falls below y = -20 (lose a life instead)

title: Patrol and chase
description: Enemy AI: walks a loop of waypoints, and when the target (usually the player) comes within sight it chases them. What it does on seeing the target is a swappable hook, so the same enemy can flee, freeze or circle instead. Fires onTouch when it reaches the target.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach
exports.signature: attach(object, opts) → { update(dt), dispose(), hooks, alert }
exports.does: moves object along its waypoints or by onSee each update; handle.hooks can be swapped at runtime

exports.name: chase
exports.does: the default onSee: a direction straight at the target

options.name: alertSpeed
options.does: speed while the target is in sight

options.name: sight
options.does: how near the target must be to be seen

hooks.name: onSee
hooks.does: (self, target) → a direction to move, or null to keep patrolling; replace it to flee, freeze or circle

hooks.name: onTouch
hooks.does: (self, target) once each time it reaches the target: hurt the player, or get bonked

title: Flee instead of chase
description: Makes a patrolling enemy run away from the player instead of chasing them when it sees them: a drop-in for patrol's onSee. Swap it in for a power-up, a scared state, or a timid creature.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: onSee
exports.does: a direction straight away from the target

title: Collectibles
description: Pickups such as coins, gems or stars: the items spin and bob, and when the collector comes near one it is collected (removed by default). Calls onAll when the last is taken, for a level-complete.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach
exports.does: animates the items and collects them as the collector touches them; left is how many remain

options.name: items
options.does: the pickups, already in the scene

options.name: bob
options.does: how far they float up and down

hooks.name: onCollect
hooks.default: remove the item from the scene
hooks.does: (item, collector) when one is picked up: score, sound, power-up

hooks.name: onAll
hooks.does: (collector) when the last one is picked up

title: Follow camera
description: Third-person camera that trails the player at an offset, easing smoothly toward them and always looking at them.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach
exports.does: moves the camera after the target each update

options.name: offset
options.does: where the camera sits relative to the target

options.name: lag
options.does: how quickly it catches up (higher is tighter)

options.name: lookAbove
options.does: look this far above the target's feet

title: Clip animator
description: Plays a rigged model's animation clips by state, crossfading between them: wire it to a controller's state so the character idles, walks, runs and jumps. Clip names default to the expressive robot's.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach
exports.does: crossfades to the clip for state() each update

options.name: state
options.does: which state to show now, e.g. () => controller.state

options.name: clips
options.default: { idle: Idle, walk: Walking, run: Running, jump: Jump }
options.does: which clip plays for each state

title: Coin rush
description: A tiny third-person platformer built entirely from warehouse parts: run and jump the robot across grass platforms and crates, grab every coin, and dodge the patrolling red robots. Grab the star and they flee from you for a few seconds, and you can bonk them. Beat your time.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Gauntlet
description: Survive as long as you can in a small grass arena while red robots chase you. A new guard arrives every six seconds, each a little faster and sharper-eyed than the last. Hide behind crates and jump over them. Built from warehouse parts: the robot, the patrol AI, the platformer controller.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Robot roundup
description: A herding game: six skittish green robots wander a field and run from you when you get close. Steer them onto the sandy pen in the corner by coming at them from the far side. Shows the patrol AI with its onSee hook swapped for flee-on-see.
author: the internet slop warehouse
